what: Wholly-v1 remote/cache harnesses, not cut line by line because the remote or BLAZE_CACHE is their subject: harness/deps.py (all of it is the v1 remote), harness/freshwarm.py (push/pull to a remote), harness/bscache.py (RUSTC_WRAPPER=blaze-rustc with BLAZE_CACHE; dropping BLAZE_CACHE would make it use the user default store), harness/allblaze.py (drives the v1 engine with BLAZE_CACHE stores). Decide delete or port to the v2 daemon; their ci.py rows go with them. Also .github/workflows/blaze-platform.yaml:280 starts MinIO for the deleted harness/remote.py (with 01017).
